goal: Glob every corpus/*.txt document, run /usr/bin/wc -w over the globbed list in one invocation, and write the captured stdout to out/summary.txt. Assert the invocation succeeded. Return a record { documents: <the globbed list>, summary: <wc stdout> }.
notes: A captured list value may be supplied directly as process.run args.
/usr/bin/wc -w prints one line per input plus a total line when given more than one path.
